items.q: Do I need to know anything about AI to work with you?
items.a: No. You tell us what's leaking (missed calls, slow follow-up, nothing to post) and we install the fix. You approve scripts and visuals for creative work and you read a monthly report. Everything else is ours.
items.say: You need a guy. Not a degree.

items.q: What happens on the Game Plan Call?
items.a: Twenty minutes with Chosen. We pull up your Scorecard numbers (or run it live), find the biggest leak, map which system seals it, and give you straight answers on price in dollars. No pitch deck. If we're not the fit, we say so and you keep the map.

items.q: How fast can something be live?
items.a: An AI Front Desk is usually answering within a week of your call. A quiz funnel takes about two weeks. Creative starts with a script you approve, then your first pieces land on the plan's schedule. We give you real dates on the call.

items.q: What is the Revenue Leak Scorecard?
items.a: A free two-minute quiz, eight questions, that estimates how much revenue is slipping out of your business each month and where. The numbers are built from industry benchmarks, so they're directional. The call is where we look at your real ones.
items.say: Two minutes. You keep the number.

items.q: What kinds of businesses do you work with?
items.a: Local service businesses: roofing, HVAC, plumbing, dental, med spas, law, vets, salons, and the like. If you're a national chain or a franchise HQ, we'll tell you on the call that we're not the right fit.

Infrastructure that runs inside your business after we install it: an AI that answers your phone and texts, a quiz funnel that captures leads, sequences that follow up forever, a chatbot that sells at 2am. It's built once, runs through your CRM, and we maintain and improve it every month.

items.q: Will the AI say something wrong to my customers?
items.a: It can make mistakes, which is why every agent we install has a named human on our team supervising it. If it's unsure it hands off to a person. If it's wrong we fix it free. Nothing runs without someone who can stop it.

items.q: Who owns the phone numbers, the list, the accounts?
items.a: You do. Your numbers, your customer list, your ad accounts, your content all live in your accounts, not ours. Walk away any time and take all of it with you.
Your data stays in your accounts and we only touch what the system needs to do its job. We never sell it, share it, or train anything public on it. Ask us anything about this on the call. Seriously.

When someone asks ChatGPT, Gemini, or Perplexity for the best roofer in their city, that's AI search. We ask all three the seven questions your customers ask, screenshot every answer, and count how often you're named out of 21. Then we work on getting you into the answer. The first audit is free.

items.q: How is creative different from a system?
items.a: A system is infrastructure that runs. Creative is production: video ads, social cuts, and branded motion made fresh every month in our studio. Systems are a flat monthly fee. Creative is priced by how much gets made. Most businesses need both, but you buy them separately and we keep them separate on purpose.

items.q: Do I have to be on camera?
items.a: No. The Content Engine is AI-produced: scripted, framed, shot, and cut by our producers the way a crew would, without the crew. You approve the script and the key visual before anything is made.

items.q: How many revisions do I get?
items.a: Feedback happens at the script and key-visual stages, where changes are free and instant. After delivery, each plan includes a set number of consolidated revision rounds (up to five specific changes per round). Genuine errors on our side, like a wrong logo or a typo, are always fixed free.
Month to month. No minimum term dressed up as a discount. Moving up or down a creative tier takes effect next billing cycle, with no fee and no re-onboarding.

items.q: Why don't you bill in credits?
items.a: Because nobody knows what a credit is worth until the bill arrives. You pay a flat monthly fee in dollars for each system, creative is priced by output, and anything beyond your plan shows up as minutes and messages at cost. If a bill ever confuses you, that's our mistake to fix.

No, and be careful with anyone who does. Any estimate you see from us is built from industry benchmarks. What we promise is a number every month, in dollars and hours, showing what actually happened, and that we keep improving the system based on it.

Eat 4 Life Marketing's animated mascot, made with the same AI tools we use for client content. He's a character, like the Gecko is a character. The people behind him are Chosen and the E4L team in Los Angeles, and a real person reads every message you send.
items.say: I'm the guy. They're the team.
